principles: Conform to the server contract: the proof endpoint is a protected read, so authenticate it; never weaken server auth
Fix the real root cause (the unauthenticated fetch), not just the smoke symptom
Server stays read-only; the change is client-only
Lock the fix with a deterministic regression test that fails without it
drivers: The gate-receipt proof endpoint is a protected Authority read and returns 401 without the customer API key
The Lattice Authority server is read-only for this story
The fix must be verifiable both deterministically (CI) and end-to-end against the real staging server

options.name: fix-both-auth-layers
pros: Fixes the real bug: any authority_receipt_verify --proofPath flow was 401ing, not just this smoke
cons: Touches a core handler (authority-enforce) plus the client (authority-client)

options.name: verify-inline-receipt-only
cons: The proofPath fetch is the intended, tested path
Does not fix the real bug; other proofPath callers still 401

rationale: Fixes the real production bug (any proofPath proof fetch was 401ing), conforms to the server protected-read contract, is minimal and client-only, and keeps the server read-only. The smoke materialOverlapAudit gap is a separate but required fix to reach the proof-fetch path at all.

preMortem.trigger: materialOverlapAudit added to the signed decision but not to the digest input
preMortem.consequence: Server recomputes a different gateInputDigest and rejects the gate request
preMortem.mitigation: Add materialOverlapAudit to BOTH buildPhaseGateRequest (digest input) and signedTargetGateRequest (signed decision)

preMortem.trigger: Only loadProof or only fetchGateReceiptProof is fixed
preMortem.consequence: Proof fetch still sends no Authorization header or fails closed client-side, and 401s
preMortem.mitigation: Fix both layers together: loadProof passes auth and fetchGateReceiptProof requests an authenticated read

preMortem.trigger: The new test asserts nothing that depends on the fix
preMortem.consequence: It always passes and never catches the regression, giving false safety
preMortem.mitigation: Confirm the test FAILS without the fix and PASSES with it

preMortem.trigger: The live smoke depends on staging credentials and mutates staging
preMortem.mitigation: The deterministic test is the CI guard; the live smoke stays env-gated and skips without staging
